segments.text: Let yourself settle in, and imagine you are warm and dry in your bed, while outside a soft rain begins to fall.
Listen. The first gentle drops against the window. Steady, and slow.
There is nowhere you need to be. The rain has the whole night to fall, and you have the whole night to rest.
Breathe in slowly. And let your breath out like a long, soft sigh.
Feel the rhythm of the rain on the roof. Soft, and even. Asking nothing of you.
Let your body grow heavy beneath the blankets. Warm, and safe, and still.
Each drop carries a little of the day away. Washing it down, and out, and gone.
The rain blurs the world outside into a soft, grey hush. Nothing sharp. Nothing urgent.
Let your thoughts dissolve into the sound, until there is only the rain, and your slow, easy breath.
Warm beneath the covers. Held by the quiet. Carried by the rain.
Let it lull you down, deeper and deeper, into sleep.
Rest now. Let the rain keep watch. Sleep well.
